title: A countable sup-dense family in C_c(ℝ^N × G) with supports in B°_R(0) × G (step 1)
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ and R > 0. There are g_m ∈ C_c(ℝ^N × G(N,n)) (m ∈ ℕ) with tsupport g_m ⊆ B°_R(0) × G(N,n) for every m such that for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N × G(N,n)) with tsupport f ⊆ B°_R(0) × G(N,n) and every η > 0 there is m with |f(z) − g_m(z)| ≤ η for all z ∈ ℝ^N × G(N,n).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (R : ℝ), 0 < R → ∃ g : ℕ → C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ), (∀ m, tsupport (g m) ⊆ ball (0 : Euclidean N) R ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) ∧ ∀ f : C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ), tsupport f ⊆ ball (0 : Euclidean N) R ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)) → ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ m, ∀ z, |f z - g m z| ≤ η
